svg.text: AFFINE.EARTH · OLIGONUCLEOTIDE SAFETY · ORDER VS COMPOSITION
A list of off-target sites decides nothing. Any 20-mer has hundreds.
The question that decides something is comparative.
Every strand was screened against SIXTEEN permutations of its own bases — the identical multiset of
A, C, G and T in a different order. A permutation is the molecule's composition with none of its design.
GENCODE v50 · 670,670 transcripts · 1,467,336,203 scoreable 20-mer windows
5,355,878,467,758 probe-windows counted as they happened · zero floating point
186 SCREENED PROBE FAMILIES — 169 REGISTRY STRANDS AND 17 UNDESIGNED CONTROLS, EACH AGAINST ITS OWN 16 PERMUTATIONS
BELOW all 16
zerlasiran guide strand,
free acid and sodium
salt — ONE sequence
8 TIE the lowest control — a tie is not fewer places
INSIDE their own control range
indistinguishable from what their own base composition forces
— measured, and NOT a safety finding
ABOVE every permutation
not a safety finding either: one integer
larger than another integer
9 TIE ALL SIXTEEN, every arm at ZERO
25 to 33 bases. The comparison is empty at four mismatches, so no rank
can be read from it. A strict-only rank rule printed these as rank 1 and
counted them as designed specificity: 19 where the honest figure is 2.
Read at its own resolving threshold, ETEPLIRSEN is ABOVE all 16.
NOT IN THIS BAR AT ALL — 18 UBIQUITOUS, 266 REFUSED, 19 NOT_KNOWN. Three silences, none of them a zero.
UBIQUITOUS: a perfect complement in 141 to 1,344 genes is not a measured target, it is a common motif — abetimus is a
pure dinucleotide repeat (GTGT… / CACA…) that pairs at every microsatellite, and a B-cell tolerogen, not an antisense medicine.
Subtracting those genes as “on-target” and publishing the remainder manufactures an off-target burden it never earned.
THE ONE SEQUENCE BELOW ITS OWN FLOOR — specificity as a property of the ORDER its bases were chosen in
zerlasiran guide 19-mer ATAACTCTGTCCATTACCG measured target LPA, LPAL2
off-target at ≤4 mismatches 965 · its 16 controls min 991 upper median 1554 max 4089
Nothing at 19/19, 18/19 or 17/19 anywhere outside its target. Measurable in integers before a molecule is ever synthesised.
A near-complementary window is a place a molecule COULD pair. NOT a cut, NOT an occupancy, NOT a clinical event, and NOT
evidence that any medicine harms anyone. A high rank is not a safety finding; a low rank is not a clearance. seal 2d74f5c676d51d45
